description: Trailhead is located off the Hobson Lake recreation site. Trail is easy going in and steep coming out up off the lake. Hence it's local name of "Bitch" Lake. Hike in, bait ban, Catch and release fishing only, closed November 01 to April 30th to fishing. Please check fishing regulations.
directions: Drive south on the Kluskus Forest Service Road to 73.5 km, turn right (west) on the Natulkuz-500 Road and drive a further 9.1 kms. Turn right (north) on the Kluskus-Hobson FSR and go a further 2.8 kms to site.
title: Chief Gray Lk. Trail
